source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The Kelermorph, while outside enemy [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range), may react once each turn during the enemy [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase). The trigger is a foe ending its move at most 8″ from the Kelermorph, whether it moved Normally, Advanced or Fell Back. If able, the Kelermorph can shoot that foe as in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), then [move Normally](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) up to D6″. Embarking in a **[TRANSPORT](vsdata:core-rule/transports)** is forbidden as part of that move.
